title: Density Settings Panel
description: An outer Shell holds a full-height end ShellSidebar that spans the header of a nested docs Shell, where accent and density radios edit a draft theme that Apply commits to the inner Shell, density to $size and accent to $hue and $textHue, and closing discards. Use it for a customization or settings drawer beside the whole app whose changes apply only on confirm, or for a docs page with an On this page sidebar shown only at wide widths.
